semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact card identity and the mandatory seven-card entry look with optional revealed planeswalker selection and random bottom.
Each controlled planeswalker death reuses the entry look and shared Oracle presentation.
Exact static definition and its Oracle presentation.
A paid cast and actual entry privately look at seven and publicly reveal only the selected planeswalker; hand, mana and library order are fixtures.
The mandatory look allows declining and handles no eligible card.
Short and empty libraries complete the look without inventing cards.
Looking is unaffected by an opponent's actual Ashiok restriction.
The random bottom order is kept internal and omitted from the private log; selected-card reveal remains public.
Accepted encoded commands replay the look and random order deterministically in the engine; this is not a network reconnect test.
A real death uses the walker's event-time controller rather than owner and preserves the captured look.
An opponent-controlled planeswalker does not produce a Carth trigger, regardless of owner.
A labeled synthetic death replacement sends the walker to exile and does not trigger the graveyard event.
Real All Is Dust removes Carth and two walkers together; captured death triggers produce two separate looks.
A synthetic planeswalker token face exercises a real death and captured trigger before token cessation.
Actual loyalty abilities expose their combined signed amounts and legality.
Printed positive and zero abilities commit their positive combined payments while preserving printed ability data.
A net zero payment succeeds under labeled synthetic counter-placement prohibition.
A real minus-three ability is payable at two loyalty and its separate death trigger survives the paid activation.
Labeled synthetic suppression and control changes exercise the live static's availability.
Labeled nonlegendary synthetic copies provide multiple active Carth statics.
A labeled synthetic type change makes the loyalty source a nonplaneswalker and removes the modifier.
An opponent's real activation uses its printed cost after real turn advancement.
Paid Carth, Oath and Veil commands apply the adjusted cost to two Oath uses and one Veil use; fixture placement and mana are labeled.
An actual paid Rings copy neither pays loyalty again nor consumes Oath's second activation.
Actual Jace Beleren's generic fallback carries the complete effective loyalty prefix.
Actual Jace Unraveler's Program fallback carries the complete effective loyalty prefix.
A synthetic copied name containing a colon remains intact when the generic identifier receives its cost prefix.
Actual walkers publish complete positive, zero and negative effective loyalty prefixes.
A labeled synthetic simple effect retains its generated body when the effective cost replaces its printed prefix.
A labeled synthetic planeswalker face using Arena's admitted staged profile publishes its complete mana, tap and loyalty cost.
Labeled modifier-bearing Arena and token-restricted Fountainport fixtures retain unattested generic fallbacks.
A synthetic admitted Arena loyalty face demonstrates live pretarget and locked posttarget payment.
Cancellation and retry pay only the successful staged activation.
Departure of a foreign source owner cleanly abandons the unpaid staged activation.
Departing actor cleanup removes the unpaid staged activation.
A positive combined cost distinguishes Season alone from Lae'zel followed by Season.
An accepted Lae'zel replacement remains in the cost receipt after its owner departs while live Season choices finish.
Accepted encoded activation, departure, choice and subsequent pass replay identically in the engine; this is not a network reconnect test.
A real Act of Treason changes which player's planeswalker activations Carth modifies.
